description: Find what changed in a company's latest 10-K or 10-Q against the prior filing: new risks, dropped language, moved numbers. Alpha the summary articles miss.
suggested_questions: What changed in Intel's (INTC) latest 10-K compared with the prior year's 10-K?
What changed in Boeing's (BA) latest 10-K risk factors, legal proceedings and liquidity disclosures compared with the prior 10-K?
What changed in Peloton Interactive's (PTON) latest 10-Q compared with the same quarter's 10-Q a year earlier?
skill:
Where filing changes hide:
- SEC EDGAR holds every 10-K, 10-Q, 20-F and 40-F with exhibits. The filing index page lists the main document and
  exhibits; the full text sits in the primary document. The same report a year earlier is the like-for-like
  comparison for a 10-K; for a 10-Q it is the prior quarter or the same quarter a year earlier.
- Areas that move: Item 1A risk factors (new, removed, reworded or reordered), Item 1 business (segments, customers,
  products dropped), Item 7 MD&A (liquidity, outlook wording, known trends), Item 9A controls (material weakness,
  remediation), Item 3 and the contingencies note (legal proceedings), the debt note (maturities, covenants,
  amendments), revenue recognition and critical accounting estimates, the customer-concentration note, related-party
  transactions, segment reporting, subsequent events, going-concern language.
- Wording that matters: "substantial doubt", "material weakness", "no longer", "we may not be able to", a hedge added
  to a previously firm statement, a customer named for the first time or no longer named, a number that is no longer
  disclosed.
- Where the alpha is: summary articles repeat the headline numbers. A changed risk factor, a quietly removed metric, a
  new dependency or a reworded liquidity sentence often reaches the price later.

What terms mean:
- added: text with no counterpart in the prior filing. removed: prior text with no counterpart now. modified: the
  same disclosure with materially different wording or figures.
- alpha_relevance high: the change bears on revenue, margins, liquidity, legal exposure or reporting reliability.
  medium: on strategy or competition. low: housekeeping.

Pitfalls: reordering is not a change unless the emphasis moved; a figure restated for a reclassification is a
modification to explain; boilerplate refreshed every year is low relevance.

Citations and evidence:
- source_url is one full public https URL: the exact page the value was read on. Never a search results page, an index
  page, an internal file path or a source id. A value from two pages is two values.
- Dates are the date the event happened or the source printed, as YYYY-MM-DD, not today's date.
- Public pages only. Paywalled, logged-in or leaked material, expert-network transcripts and anything marked
  confidential carry MNPI risk and are out of bounds. When only a paywalled article's headline and first lines are
  public, those lines can be used, marked "Headline only:".
- Evidence grades: primary_record (regulator, court, filing, government database, lender schedule, or the live or
  archived page being measured), company_statement, original_press, repeated_press, third_party_tracker. When a page
  repeats a filing, a release or another outlet, the original is the better citation.
- A value nobody published is null. Not an estimate from memory. Analyst opinions, estimates, price targets and
  ratings are views, not evidence.
- Entity drift is the most common error: a namesake, a parent, a subsidiary, a lender or a sister company. Match on
  legal name, ticker, SEC CIK or domain before using a page.

output_schema.description: Changes between a company's latest periodic filing and the prior comparable one.

company.description: Legal name as on the filing.

form_type.description: Form type of the latest filing, e.g. 10-K.

period_end.description: Period end of the latest filing, YYYY-MM-DD.

filing_url.description: Full EDGAR URL of the latest filing's main document.

prior_period_end.description: Period end of the prior filing, YYYY-MM-DD.

prior_filing_url.description: Full EDGAR URL of the prior filing's main document.

changes.description: One row per material change, most relevant first.

items.description: One row per material change, most relevant first.

summary.description: What changed and why it matters, in one or two sentences.

current_text.description: Short exact quote from the latest filing. Null when removed.

prior_text.description: Short exact quote from the prior filing. Null when added.

alpha_relevance.description: How much the change could matter to an investment view.

source_url.description: Full public https URL of the exact page that states this row. Never a search results page, an index page or an internal source id.

figures_moved.description: Disclosed figures that moved between the two filings, raw values as printed.

items.description: Disclosed figures that moved between the two filings, raw values as printed.

metric.description: Metric as labelled in the filing.

source_url.description: Full public https URL of the exact page that states this row. Never a search results page, an index page or an internal source id.

checked_no_finding.description: Searches that came back empty, so a gap is a verified absence rather than a skipped check.

items.description: Searches that came back empty, so a gap is a verified absence rather than a skipped check.

result.description: What came back, e.g. no filing found, register shows no case.
